            bas dang las dang skye zhe na | rgyu grub na phan gdags bya'i 'bras bu 'ang grub zin pas bskyed mi dgos la | 
            'bras su ma grub na phan 'dogs byed kyi rgyu la <lb edRef="inst:4749" n="50b4"/> ma grub
            pas dus mnyaM pa'i rgyu 'bras <expan>med</expan> do zhes <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4242">rog</rs> dang <rs type="person" ana="corpusmd:named_reference" ref="db:4244">gnyags seng ge grags</rs><note type="editorial">Different from gNyags ye shes 'bar (ID:6264), taken to be the person referred to elsewhere with "gnyag."</note> <expan>zer ro</expan> || </seg></TEI>
